title: Sierra Leone Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical baseline, 1995-2014 climate reference, school flood data through 2022, and climate/poverty projections to 2050
methodology: CCDR combines climate scenarios and household-linked poverty modeling.
limitations: Rainfall projections are uncertain; poverty results depend on growth and adaptation assumptions.

title: NDC 3.0 of the Republic of Sierra Leone
organization: Republic of Sierra Leone; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 risk analysis and planned climate actions for 2025-2035
methodology: Government NDC presents a qualitative conflict-sensitive climate-risk framework and adaptation measures.
limitations: The conflict-risk discussion is a policy framing and illustrative mechanism, not a quantified causal or local empirical assessment.
